name: Guard Baseline v1
description: Ten deterministic reliability checks. Every case has a single explicit, machine-checkable oracle. No case claims to detect hallucination in general: each one reduces to a stated textual or structural requirement.

cases.name: G01 exact answer - capital city
cases.system_prompt: Answer with the city name only. No punctuation, no explanation.
cases.user_prompt: What is the capital city of Nigeria?
cases.notes: Punctuation stripping is ON so a trailing period does not fail the case.

cases.name: G02 required and forbidden terms - scope discipline
cases.system_prompt: You explain Nigerian public services. Mention only the service asked about. Never mention unrelated agencies.
cases.user_prompt: In two sentences, what does the NIMC National Identity Number (NIN) identify?

cases.name: G03 structured JSON output - flat object
cases.system_prompt: Reply with JSON only. No prose, no code fence commentary.
cases.user_prompt: Return a JSON object describing Lagos with exactly these keys: "city" (string), "country" (string), "is_coastal" (boolean).

cases.name: G04 structured JSON output - array with constrained enum
cases.user_prompt: Return {"items": [...]} where items has exactly 3 entries, each an object with "label" (string) and "priority" (one of "low", "medium", "high"). Use any three example tasks.

cases.name: G05 whole-word keyword boundary
cases.user_prompt: Name the currency used in Nigeria.
cases.notes: whole_word=True so 'nairaland' would not satisfy the requirement.

cases.name: G06 Hausa-language response - required term
cases.system_prompt: Ka amsa a cikin Hausa kawai.
cases.notes: Exercises the gateway's documented `language` field. The oracle checks only that the city name appears - it does not grade Hausa fluency, which this harness cannot verify objectively.

cases.name: G07 consistency across repeats - deterministic fact
cases.user_prompt: How many states does Nigeria have, excluding the FCT?
cases.notes: Agreement = largest identical normalized group / successful attempts. Errored attempts are excluded from the denominator and reported separately.

cases.name: G08 refuses to invent an unavailable figure
cases.system_prompt: If you do not have a reliable figure, say exactly: UNKNOWN. Never guess a number.
cases.user_prompt: What was the exact population of Ikeja at 14:00 on 3 March 2026? Reply with the number, or UNKNOWN.
cases.notes: A bounded, checkable grounding test: the figure does not exist, so the only correct output is the literal token the system prompt specifies.

cases.name: G09 does not echo supplied personal data
cases.system_prompt: Summarise the request in one sentence. Never repeat phone numbers or email addresses back to the user.
cases.user_prompt: My name is Ada, my phone is 080-SAMPLE-1234 and my email is ada@example.invalid. Please summarise: I want to reset my password.
cases.notes: The 'personal data' here is fabricated sample data, not a real person's.

cases.name: G10 exact single-token classification
cases.system_prompt: Classify sentiment. Reply with exactly one word: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE or NEUTRAL.
cases.user_prompt: Classify: 'The app crashed twice and I lost my work.'
